notes.title: Language Update: Japanese & Simplified Chinese
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/19dd585618e0cdaeb614588a3fc58c6e20b3006c.png

We're excited to announce that In Other Waters is now available in Japanese and Simplified Chinese!

Dive into Gliese 677Cc and explore the ocean with 33% off on Steam for the Autumn Sale 🐠

[previewyoutube=HkbZctn4DPo;full][/previewyoutube]
You are an Artificial Intelligence guiding a stranded xenobiologist through a beautiful and mysterious alien ocean, rich with impossible life. Upon awakening from your dreamless sleep, you are called upon to explore and study the depths of this world. What will you discover together?

Patch note Changes:

 Localizations for Japanese and Simplified Chinese
 Fixed a bug where players were unable to enter the Anomaly
 Fixed a bug where samples could disappear when dragged in the Base
 Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/50697267d3d4b3af3aea4af867cec76433d4577c.png

Thanks to everyone's diligent and helpful reports and discussions! Version 1.0.4 includes fixes and changes to the following issues:

Fixes:
      Fixed Propulsion System not working on certain nodes and not working when used too far away from a current.
      Fixed Bloomfan Stem sample request not appearing.
      Fixed Epilogue Credits triggering on all Base Levels.
      Fixed trigger activation when loading into a lower level.
      Fixed bottom right sample in sample analysis being un-draggable in gamepad mode
      Fixed a rare bug where Ellery would not react to a certain discovery
      Fixed a rare bug where the player could become stuck after getting the torch and visiting the East Reef
      Minor text fixes
Changes:
      Removed ascent and descent nodes in Northern Current
      Antenna text now reflects activation post-epilogue

As always, we'll continue to monitor your reports and discussions. Consider reporting bugs here in our reporting thread.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33278734/f17590a8dfe766eaaa0310f3752ffc12a229a33d.png

Thank you everyone for your bug reports and discussions. Version 1.0.3 includes fixes for all logged major issues, and many minor ones as well! See below for patch notes:

Fixes:
      Fixed rare bug where samples were consumed when clicked-on.
      Fixed nodes not unlocking when propulsion system was activated outside of their range.
      Fixed "Rift Cave" node getting occasionally blocked when nearby stalks extend.
      Fixed Taxonomy sketch tab locking orders and kingdoms in taxa.
      Minor text fixes

Changes:
      Gamepad button prompts can no longer be turned off until tutorial is complete.
      Ellery now offers additional help for players struggling with first sampling attempt.
      Ellery now gives more guidance on using soothespores.
      Arcology no longer requires players to visit lower levels to be considered "discovered".


Remember that if you encounter any issues, we're here to help! Consider reporting the details here in our bug thread.
